newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka gains at close on dollar supply.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka gains at close on dollar supply.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed firmer at 42.5475/5490 to the dollar in interbank trading compared with the previous 42.5490/5495, dealers said.
Dealers said the taka was quoted at 42.5485/5500 in early trade but gained later on higher dollar supply.
Early deals were done in 42.5490/5495 range but some banks, anxious to square their positions before the Moslem Friday weekend, quoted the local unit at 42.5475 to the dollar later in the session.
The interbank call money rates finished at 4.5 percent to 5.5, unchanged from Wednesday's level, dealers said. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
